name: monorail-figma-plugin
description: Monorail plugin for Figma - converts IR to slides

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
scripts.check:bundle: esbuild code.ts --bundle --outfile=code.check.js --target=es2017 && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=fs.readFileSync('code.js','utf8'),b=fs.readFileSync('code.check.js','utf8');fs.unlinkSync('code.check.js');if(a!==b){console.error('code.js is STALE — run npm run build and commit the result');process.exit(1)}console.log('code.js matches code.ts')"
